class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackProcedural
class.description: Created by [method AudioStream.instantiate_playback] on an [AudioStreamProcedural]. Each playback owns an independent copy of the compiled graph state, so several playbacks of one stream do not interfere. Seeking re-renders the graph from time zero because filters and delays are recursive.

method.name: is_graph_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the graph compiled successfully; otherwise the playback outputs silence.
